column1: # brand/surfaces.tsv — the ONE register of the product's brand surfaces.
# Read by `scripts/check-brand.py` (the `brand` task, and hooks/pre-commit). One row per
# tracked file that names the tagline:
#   repo <TAB> path <TAB> the exact text the surface must carry
# `repo` is a path under the umbrella root (`.` is the umbrella itself). A repo that is
# not materialised in the current checkout is reported as SKIP, never treated as a pass.
# The expected text is matched whitespace-normalised, so a wrapped paragraph still fits;
# markdown punctuation is part of the expected text where the punctuation is load-bearing
# (a README hero must be ONE bold run, or the docs landing page cannot lift it).
# A surface that names the tagline WITHOUT a row here fails the coverage arm. That is the
# arm that closes the class this register exists for: each of the five renames swept the
# surfaces its author remembered, and the surface it forgot went on shipping a dead
# tagline for two brand generations (see scripts/check-brand.py's header).
# Generated trees are registered here too — they are brand surfaces, and the row is what
# makes a STALE regeneration a finding instead of a surprise.
